css: body { font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt; line-height: 1.55; color: #24292e; } h1, h2, h3, h4, h5, h6 { font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; } h1 { page-break-before: always; font-size: 22pt; margin: 0 0 0.6em; padding-bottom: 0.2em; border-bottom: 2px solid #d0d7de; } h1:first-of-type { page-break-before: avoid; } h2 { font-size: 17pt; margin: 1.4em 0 0.5em; padding-bottom: 0.15em; border-bottom: 1px solid #eaecef; } h3 { font-size: 13pt; margin: 1.2em 0 0.4em; } h4 { font-size: 11.5pt; margin: 1em 0 0.3em; } a { color: #0366d6; text-decoration: none; } p { margin: 0.6em 0; } ul, ol { margin: 0.6em 0; padding-left: 1.6em; } table { border-collapse: collapse; width: 100%; margin: 1em 0; font-size: 10pt; } th, td { border: 1px solid #d0d7de; padding: 6px 10px; text-align: left; vertical-align: top; } th { background: #f6f8fa; font-weight: 600; } tr:nth-child(even) td { background: #fbfcfd; } code { font-family: 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', Menlo, monospace; background: rgba(175,184,193,0.2); padding: 0.15em 0.35em; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 9.5pt; } pre { background: #f6f8fa; padding: 12px 14px; border-radius: 6px; overflow-x: auto; line-height: 1.45; } pre code { background: transparent; padding: 0; font-size: 9.5pt; } blockquote { margin: 0.8em 0; padding: 0 1em; color: #57606a; border-left: 4px solid #d0d7de; } hr { border: 0; border-top: 1px solid #e1e4e8; margin: 1.6em 0; } img { max-width: 100%; } .page-break { page-break-after: always; }
